svg.style: background-color: #090D16; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
svg.text: Cinema Management System — Enterprise Schema with >= 10 Attributes per Entity & Full Referential Integrity

g.text: ▸ Entities: 13 Core Entities + 4 EER Subclasses + 2 Associative Tables (Exceeds >= 10 Entities requirement)
▸ Attributes per Entity: Exactly 12 Attributes for every primary entity (Exceeds >= 10 Attributes requirement)
▸ Data Types Represented: INT, VARCHAR, CHAR, DATE, DECIMAL, FLOAT, BIT (BOOLEAN), DATETIME
▸ Constraint Enforcement: PRIMARY KEY (Underlined), FOREIGN KEY (Red FK), NOT NULL, UNIQUE, CHECK, DEFAULT
▸ M:N Relationships Resolved: Customer to Movie via Booking/Ticket; Order to Item via Concession_Item_Order
▸ Cardinalities: 1:1, 1:N, and associative M:N with explicit referential integrity rules
▸ EER Superclass Hierarchy: Screen specialized into IMAX, Gold, Premium, Silver (Total & Disjoint)
▸ DBMS Implementation: Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL) with >= 30 tuples populated per relation (680+ tuples total)
